notes:
Four web releases in one update, and this one installs normally - no uninstall.

REPORT AND TAKE DOWN. Every listing, every trader and every conversation now has a flag on it. Seven reasons, an optional note, and it goes to a person - nothing comes down automatically, and you will not hear back. Reporting a conversation works after it has closed, which is when you usually find out something went wrong. A moderator can now remove a listing outright: it leaves the board, its photo is deleted, every conversation about it closes, and both the seller and anyone mid-negotiation are told it was moderated rather than left to assume the other player walked away.

SELL PART OF A LISTING. Sell 2 of 96 and the other 94 stays up. The seller enters the amount when they close the deal out.

QUALITY ON EVERYTHING, optional, and as a RANGE on both sides. A mixed 96 SCU lot running q400 to q900 has no honest single number, and being made to pick one put a false precision on the board in the same type as a true one.

SEARCH, with price and quality bounds. Words match in any order, so "idris kit" finds "Kit for an Idris".

BUY and SELL on the card, where it used to say "I want this" and "I have this".

FIXED. Prices group as you type - 1,000,000 rather than 1000000, on the one field where a mistyped zero costs money. "each" now says what it is per: per SCU for ore, each for something you named yourself. Photos are no longer cropped to a letterbox band. Tapping "List something" three times while it loads opens one sheet instead of three. A card that printed "0.6 x Iron" for 0.569 SCU no longer disagrees with its own total. RSI verify with an empty box no longer says "That is not an RSI handle" about a name you had not typed yet.

DATA. No Star Citizen data changed in this build.
